name: The Evening Kitchen
tagline: The cookbook as a table lit by one pendant lamp after work: dishes glow out of a deep aubergine room, and Daylight turns the lamp into sun through a kitchen window.
thesis: Most home cooking happens after work, in low warm light, so the page is set in that scene. Deep aubergine ground, brass accents and a soft falloff of lamp light let the real food photos glow like plates on a dark table, while Bodoni Moda headings read like a restaurant menu card. Chrome is sparse and typographic (minutes and lei, no emoji), so the page stays a fast 'what do I cook tonight' tool with images at its centre.
fonts: Bodoni Moda (optical sizes 6–96) — greeting, wordmark, section headings and dish names; the menu-card voice, and its opsz axis keeps hairlines sturdy at card-title sizes
Hanken Grotesk — all UI, body and figures (tabular minutes and lei); warm grotesk that stays crisp at 15px on dark

palette.name: Walnut shadow
palette.role: Dark drawer and footer, one step deeper

palette.name: Brass
palette.role: Dark accent: prices, switch, selected chips, the lamp glow

highlights: Signature: the category rail at the top of the page carries the lamp. The section you are scrolling through is the lit pill; it glides between categories using a clip-path, and in Daylight it becomes a solid ink tab

Light itself changes between themes: a warm pendant-lamp pool at dusk and blurred window panes by day. Photos get a soft vignette at night and none in Daylight, so the light theme is designed as its own counterpart rather than a colour inversion

Cards are frameless 4:5 plates with a Bodoni title and one typographic meta line ('30 min · ≈ 2,04 lei'). '≈' marks a partial estimate, '—' shows when there is no price, and screen readers get the full cost label. On sort/filter changes the plates fade up from dim, as if the lights were coming on

Active filters are visible on the page as removable chips, with a count badge on both the Filters and menu buttons. The drawer adds a live 'Show N recipes' button, category rows with round plate thumbnails, and focus trap, inert page, Escape, backdrop close and scroll lock

Today's pick shows one real recipe, chosen by date, as a large lit plate beside the greeting. It hides while you search or filter so results start at the top. Search ignores diacritics, so 'ciorba' finds 'ciorbă'
tradeoffs: Bodoni Moda is a high-contrast face. It holds up here because of optical sizing, but Tailwind needs font-variation settings and the variable font file is heavier than a single static cut
The 480px square webp thumbs look soft in the 4-column desktop grid on 2x screens. Production should generate 800px thumbs or add a srcset
The sticky rail and lamp light need scroll tracking and an extra layer of CSS; the React port needs an IntersectionObserver hook and must be tuned carefully so nothing jitters
